hero.title: Every journey, handled with comfort, discretion and precision from the very first mile.
hero.subtitle:
Carefully selected drivers. Premium electric vehicles.
A solid, reliable standard for those who do not improvise their mobility in Mexico City.

local.title: Mexico City, mobility at a higher standard.
local.body: Clean routes, controlled timing and a consistent experience. Designed for work, travel and special occasions.

standard.title: A standard designed for silence.
standard.subtitle:
High-end electric mobility.
Space. Calm. Stability.
standard.origin: Pixkuy takes its name from Totonac, one of Mexico’s indigenous languages. It means “roadrunner”. A way of naming what is essential: the detail that sustains. That same logic defines the standard through which we understand mobility.

services.title: Not every need is the same.
services.item2: Hourly or multi-day services with continuous coverage.
services.item3: Events and occasions that require precision.
services.bridge: Pixkuy is built for those who value planning, discretion and a stable service standard.

intro.title: The Pixkuy experience is also defined by the vehicle.
intro.subtitle: Not every journey requires the same space, nor does every car offer the same experience.

zeekr.title: Zeekr 001
zeekr.subtitle: Executive electric sedan
zeekr.desc: Silence, stability and comfort for longer journeys.
zeekr.note: Designed for transfers where the journey itself is part of the agenda.

m9.title: BYD M9

m9.desc: Real space for people, luggage and working on the move.
m9.note: Built for trips involving guests or multiple operational needs.
